key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:83D8
name: dispatch_matching_table_entries
description: Walks a table of 38-byte records from its first record, skipping inactive ones, and calls a routine for each active record whose index field matches the current counter value. The counter counts down from its initial value to -1, and the flag word selects which of the two routine call paths runs.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:83DE
name: step_position_nine_times
description: Saves a 16-bit position field of the object, calls a routine nine times while advancing that field by 16 each time, then writes the original value back. It is a fixed nine-step repeat of a routine call.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:83FE
name: draw_masked_sprite_from_object
description: Computes the screen position of a sprite object from its coordinate fields, returns if it is off-screen, and clips the top and left edges. It then blits three bitplanes of sprite data into the screen, using the fourth plane as a mask and a pixel shift of 0 to 15 bits.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:842A
name: draw_masked_sprite_stored_pos
description: Recomputes the clipped screen coordinates of a sprite and stores them back into the object record. It then draws the masked three-plane sprite with a sub-word pixel shift, using the fourth plane as the mask.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8458
name: draw_masked_sprite_cached_pos
description: Draws the clipped masked sprite using screen coordinates already stored in the object record. It shares the pixel-shift and mask blitting of its sibling routines but skips the coordinate calculation.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8482
name: clear_clipped_masked_region
description: Clips a rectangle whose position and size are passed in registers, then ANDs the shifted mask plane into four bitplanes to clear the covered pixels. It writes no sprite data, so the region is erased rather than drawn.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:848C
name: clear_clipped_masked_region_raised
description: Clips a rectangle passed in registers with its top edge moved up one row, then ANDs the shifted mask plane into four bitplanes to clear the covered pixels. The mask's fourth plane is used as the clearing source, so no sprite data is written.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:849E
name: clear_wrapped_masked_strip
description: Clips a one-row-high vertical strip whose horizontal position wraps around the screen edge, then clears the covered pixels across four bitplanes using the shifted mask plane. The strip height and row skip come from the caller's registers.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:84AA
name: draw_masked_sprite_block
description: Draws a block of sprite data into four bitplanes by ORing the source planes into the screen after clearing the masked pixels with the fourth plane. It clips against the screen width and skips rows when the source is offset.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:84BC
name: clear_masked_strip_rows
description: Clears a strip of rows in four bitplanes using the shifted mask plane, with the same clipping and row stepping as the other masked blitters but without the wrap-around column.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:84C4
name: blit_clipped_sprite_rows_shifted
description: Clips a sprite rectangle to the screen edges and computes a sub-word pixel shift, then walks its rows. Depending on the flag bits it either ANDs the mask into four bitplanes, or ORs the shifted source words in where the mask is set.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8538
name: blit_sprite_rows_unclipped
description: Draws a sprite block into four bitplanes without edge clipping, applying a pixel shift and a row stride taken from the caller's registers. A second path runs when a flag bit is set and steps the source pointer by a fixed amount instead.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:854E
name: draw_masked_sprite_rows_aligned
description: Draws an unshifted, word-aligned masked sprite block into four bitplanes. Source words are written directly where the mask is empty, and otherwise combined with the existing screen words.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8578
name: fill_rectangle_with_plane_colors
description: Fills a rectangle in four bitplanes with constant plane values held in registers, combining each word with the mask so only the selected pixels change. It steps through the rows using the screen stride.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:85A4
name: draw_byte_aligned_sprite_rows
description: Copies byte-aligned sprite data into four bitplanes, using AND and OR masks drawn from the extra mask bytes of the source, and advances two bytes per column.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8616
name: draw_masked_sprite_rows_shifted
description: Draws a masked sprite block into four bitplanes without clipping, shifting each source word right by the bit count held in a register. The fourth plane is used as the transparency mask.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:869A
name: draw_masked_rows_reverse_shift
description: Draws a masked sprite block into four bitplanes with a pixel shift computed as sixteen minus the bit count, so the shift runs in the opposite direction to its sibling. The fourth plane is used as the transparency mask.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8722
name: copy_sprite_columns_from_table
description: Copies a column-major block of four-plane sprite words from a fixed source offset into the screen. Where the fourth plane is zero it writes the data directly, and otherwise it merges it with the existing words.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8734
name: copy_sprite_block_with_mask
description: Copies a block of four-plane sprite words into the screen, writing directly where the fourth-plane mask is zero and merging with the destination elsewhere. Source rows start six bytes into the sprite data.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8760
name: fill_rows_from_plane_colors
description: Writes constant plane values into a rectangle of four bitplanes, masked by a register value, and clears the fourth plane for each row. Rows advance using the screen stride held in a register.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8792
name: merge_sprite_rows_bytewise
description: Merges sprite rows into four bitplanes one byte at a time, ANDing and ORing against byte masks taken from the extra planes of the source. The second path, used when the flag bit is clear, switches to a different source offset and column count.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:880C
name: blit_masked_rows_shift_count
description: Draws a masked sprite block into four bitplanes with a sub-word shift set by a register, applying the mask and data words to each plane. It does not clip, and it steps through rows by the screen stride.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:888E
name: blit_masked_rows_reverse_count
description: Draws a masked sprite block into four bitplanes with the shift computed as sixteen minus the register value, so it shifts in the opposite direction to its sibling blitter. It does no clipping.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8914
name: call_two_routines_then_library
description: Calls two runtime routines and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable, at a fixed offset. It returns the library result without further work.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8932
name: call_two_routines_then_library
description: Calls two runtime routines and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable, at a fixed offset. It is a duplicate of the sibling routine with the same sequence.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8950
name: call_six_routines_then_library
description: Calls six runtime routines in sequence and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable. It is a fixed chain of routine calls followed by one library call.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:899C
name: unpack_run_length_stream
description: Decodes a run-length packed byte stream into a global buffer. Plain bytes are copied, and a marker byte of 178 introduces a count that repeats the next value or copies a literal run, stopping when the count reaches eight.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:89AC
name: call_five_routines_then_library
description: Calls five runtime routines in sequence and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable. It is a fixed chain of routine calls followed by one library call.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:89EE
name: call_three_routines_then_library
description: Calls three runtime routines in sequence and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable. It is a fixed chain of routine calls followed by one library call.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8A10
name: call_three_routines_then_library
description: Calls three runtime routines in sequence and then a library function reached through the library base stored in a global variable. It is a duplicate of the sibling routine with the same sequence.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8A32
name: unpack_run_length_mode_one
description: Stores the selector value one in a global, calls a routine, and then decodes a run-length packed stream into the global buffer. The decoding follows the same marker and count scheme as its siblings.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8A5A
name: unpack_run_length_mode_two
description: Stores the selector value two in a global, calls routines, and then decodes a run-length packed stream into the global buffer. The decoding follows the same marker and count scheme as its siblings.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8A82
name: unpack_run_length_mode_three
description: Stores the selector value three in a global, calls routines, and then decodes a run-length packed stream into the global buffer. The decoding follows the same marker and count scheme as its siblings.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8AAA
name: unpack_runs_into_buffer
description: Decodes a run-length packed stream from the global source pointer into a caller-supplied buffer, using the same marker byte of 178 and the same counts. It calls routines before and after the decoding loop.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8AF8
name: fill_bytes_then_decode_runs
description: Writes a repeated byte value into the output a set number of times, then decodes a run-length packed stream, stopping when a count of eight is reached. It is a seed-fill followed by the run-length decoder.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B04
name: decode_runs_after_seed_byte
description: Writes a seed byte, then decodes a run-length packed stream from the source, copying literal bytes and repeating marked values until the count of eight is reached.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B08
name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B0C
name: init_four_audio_channels
description: Writes default period, length, and volume values to the four Paula audio channel registers, then sets the global state fields and the audio enable value.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B7A
name: wait_for_global_flag_clear
description: Sets a global flag to one, calls a routine, then busy-waits until the flag returns to zero, which an interrupt routine clears when it finishes.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B90
name: set_state_five_audio_irqs
description: Sets a state global to five and then to one, writes the audio interrupt enable bits to the interrupt control register, and finally stores fifteen in the state global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8B9C
name: enable_audio_interrupts_if_idle
description: If the state global is zero, sets it to eight, sets it to one, writes the audio interrupt enable bits to the interrupt control register, and stores fifteen in the state global. Otherwise it returns without changes.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8BB2
name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8BB4
name: set_state_three_audio_irqs
description: Sets a state global to three and then to one, writes the audio interrupt enable bits to the interrupt control register, and finally stores fifteen in the state global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8BC0
name: set_state_two_audio_irqs
description: Sets a state global to two and then to one, writes the audio interrupt enable bits to the interrupt control register, and finally stores fifteen in the state global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:8BC8
name: set_state_one_audio_irqs
description: Sets a state global to one, writes the audio interrupt enable bits to the interrupt control register, and stores fifteen in the state global. Five routines call it.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:90C8
name: store_pointer_then_run_five
description: Stores its pointer argument in a global, then calls five runtime routines in sequence.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:90EA
name: initialise_system_libraries_and_memory
description: Zero-fills the global data area, looks up the current task and clears its signal field, opens the library bases it needs, and allocates a memory block. If any step fails, it stops in an endless loop.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:919A
name: install_interrupt_server_then_halt
description: Calls the operating system to install an interrupt server through the library base, then loops forever.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:91F8
name: setup_playfield_display_registers
description: Sets the display window, data fetch, and bitplane modulo registers, then starts the copper list and writes the playfield control register after a delay loop.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:92C0
name: setup_copper_plane_pointers
description: Writes the high and low words of four bitplane addresses into copper list entries spaced 8000 bytes apart. It then copies sixteen words from the source table into a buffer, doubling each value.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9308
name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four runtime routines in order and returns, with no other work.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9332
name: poll_library_until_ready
description: Repeatedly calls a library function until it returns a nonzero result. Each failed attempt calls a second routine, advances a global counter by 256, calls a routine, and spins a fixed delay loop before retrying.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9382
name: store_argument_to_global
description: Stores its register argument in a global variable.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:938E
name: call_library_or_halt
description: Calls a library function and saves its result in a global. If the result is zero, it calls the handler pointer stored in a global and then halts in an endless loop.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:93EC
name: call_global_handler_then_halt
description: Calls the handler pointer stored in a global variable and then loops forever.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:93F6
name: cycle_state_and_run_handlers
description: Advances a three-state counter global, resets it when it reaches one, calls the stored handler pointer, runs three runtime routines, and sets the state back to one.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:95FA
name: clear_four_globals
description: Sets four global variables to zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9618
name: encode_direction_bits_clamped
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a branch-heavy bit encoder. It sets flag bits from a packed direction value, then applies a ten-unit adjustment clamped at zero and stores the result in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:962E
name: encode_direction_bits_variant_a
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a variant of the direction bit encoder. It sets the same flag bits from a stored value, applies the ten-unit clamped adjustment, and writes the result to a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9640
name: encode_direction_bits_register
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as the direction bit encoder working on a register value. It sets the flag bits from a global, applies the clamped ten-unit adjustment, and stores the result in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9652
name: encode_direction_bits_register_b
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as the direction bit encoder working on a register value with a different entry test. It sets the flag bits from a global and stores the clamped result.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9672
name: encode_direction_bits_partial
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a shorter direction bit encoder. It sets one or two flag bits from a register value and stores the result in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:96B6
name: encode_direction_bits_global_only
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a direction bit encoder reading only a global. It sets flag bits, applies the clamped ten-unit adjustment, and stores the result.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:96D0
name: encode_direction_bits_argument_low
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a direction bit encoder driven by a register argument and a global. It sets a flag bit and then applies the clamped ten-unit adjustment.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:96F6
name: encode_direction_bits_argument_high
description: Unreached fragment that decodes as a direction bit encoder driven by a register argument and a global. It sets a flag bit and then applies the clamped ten-unit adjustment in the opposite direction.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:973A
name: subtract_ten_clamp_at_zero
description: Subtracts ten from a register value, clamps the result at zero, and stores it in a global. It then applies a second clamped adjustment to the global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:976A
name: subtract_ten_store_clamped
description: Subtracts ten from a register value, clamps the result at zero, and stores it in a global. This is an unreached fragment.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:977E
name: decode_joystick_port_direction
description: Reads the joystick port one movement register and builds a byte of direction flags, covering the four directions and a flag bit in the upper half, which it stores in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:97B8
name: decode_joystick_direction_from_argument
description: Builds the direction flag bits from a raw joystick argument and stores them in a global, adding the flag bit when the global's state bit is clear.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:97DC
name: read_fire_button_bits
description: Reads the fire button state from the CIA port register bit and sets a flag bit in a register accordingly, then stores the result in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9802
name: compute_pointer_movement_deltas
description: Computes horizontal and vertical pointer movement from the previous and current counter values, storing each delta clamped to a limit in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:981C
name: read_right_and_middle_buttons
description: Reads the right and middle mouse button states from the potentiometer port registers and stores them as bits in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9846
name: compute_mouse_port_movement_deltas
description: Reads the mouse port movement register and computes horizontal and vertical deltas from the previous counter values, storing each one clamped to a limit in a global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9892
name: clamp_floor_and_subtract_step
description: Raises a register value to at least the global floor, stores it, then subtracts a step value and stores the clamped difference back in the global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:98C4
name: clamp_value_to_floor_global
description: Raises a register value to at least the global floor and stores the result in the global.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:98DC
name: set_global_to_minus_one
description: Stores the value minus one in a global variable.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:98E6
name: wait_until_global_zero
description: Busy-waits until a global variable becomes zero, which an interrupt or routine clears when it finishes.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:98F4
name: update_bit6_from_low_nibble
description: If the low four bits of the argument differ from the stored value, updates the stored value and sets or clears bit 64 for each of those four bits.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX].adf:jedi:0:9904
name: store_bit6_from_low_nibble
description: Stores the argument in a global and sets or clears bit 64 according to each of its low four bits.
